text:
dana: Heads-up — seeing a token-latency spike for /generate-route (tenant: acme) starting ~02:00 UTC. p95 token latency jumped 120ms -> 410ms. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/route-slo?panel=generate-route :eyes:
aj: I pulled a profiler snapshot from the impacted hosts. SM occupancy drops right when latency climbs and kernel-selector is falling back to the slower fp32 matmul for long sequences (>2048). KV-cache hit rate stayed ~88% but prefetch miss rate increased.
liam: ops-bot flagged GPU thermal on gpu-101/gpu-102 — temp rising to ~84C and power spikes coincident with the spike. Could be MIG slice contention after the autoscaler tweak.
priya: We rolled the kernel-selector tuning change ~01:45 UTC as a canary. That aligns with the timeline. Can we rollback that flag on canary group? :thinking_face:
dana: Yes please rollback canary immediately. Also we need per-route SM occupancy and per-kernel time breakdowns on the token-latency dashboard. Right now it's only aggregate.
aj: Putting the rollback patch now (will update). In the meantime, attaching quick PromQL snippets I'm using: 
```
# per-route p95 token latency
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_token_duration_bucket{route="/generate-route"}[5m])) by (le))

# kernel selector fallback rate (per host)
sum(rate(kernel_selector_fallback_total[5m])) by (host, kernel_variant)

# SM occupancy per GPU
avg_over_time(gpu_sm_occupancy_percent[5m]) by (gpu)
```
liam: ops-bot: deploy-log shows autoscaler config applied at 01:40 with new slice allocation policy. Possibly reduced slice caps for these nodes. ops-bot: thermal/power logs attached to CI run 1854319000.
ops-bot: Attached logs: s3://redwood-ops-logs/gpu-thermals/1854319000.tar.gz
priya: If rollback fixes it, we should still add guardrails to avoid kernel fallback for large seqs — maybe increase preferred-kernel threshold or add a route-level override.
sam: Created INF-4123 to track: "Regression: /generate-route p95 token latency spike — investigate kernel selector + MIG/thermal". Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-4123
nina: Quick mitigation idea: pin /generate-route to quantized model variant on the affected capacity pool to lower VRAM pressure and reduce KV eviction churn. Would buy time while we debug selector. :thumbsup:
aj: I'm starting an A/B on 3 hosts with quantized variant pinned and kernel-selector rolled back on the canary hosts. Will monitor p95 and SM occupancy for 30m.
dana: Nice. Follow-ups: (1) add per-route per-kernel timing panel to Grafana, (2) add KV prefetch/miss to token breakdown, (3) add MIG-slice utilization heatmap, (4) run microprofiler sweep on affected hosts for 1h and attach traces to INF-4123.
priya: I'll own the Grafana panels. Assigning myself.
sam: I'll add the microprofiler job and upload traces to the ticket.
aj: Rollback applied to canary. Early signs: p95 on canary down from 410ms -> 150ms, SM occupancy back to expected baselines. Keeping A/B running on quantized pool for 20 more minutes.
dana: Great. Once A/B completes, post results and we'll decide whether to fully revert selector change or adjust thresholds. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
